item.title: Flouting road rules in Queensland about to become much more expensive
item.description: The state government has significantly raised fines for speeding, running a red light and not wearing a seatbelt.

item.title: Soggy conditions could put a dampener on Easter plans in Far North Queensland
item.description: The Easter Bunny will be searching for undercover areas to hide eggs this year, with showers predicted across much of Far North Qld this long weekend.

item.title: Ruptured gas main leads to emergency situation being declared in Cairns
item.description: Queensland Police have made an emergency declaration under the Public Safety Preservation Act due to a gas leak at Cairns North.

item.title: Cyclone expected to develop in the Coral Sea this week
item.description: Meteorologists in several countries are closely monitoring a system which is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone as early as Wednesday.

item.title: The business of art: tips on buying, collecting and investing in art ahead of CIAF
item.description: Tropic Now looks into the world of art investment, from entering the market as a collector to recognising which works will likely grow in value.
